data.narrative:
Reflex Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $7M to date. The robotics sector contains one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable to this valuation. Using total capital raised ($7M) as a proxy for post-money Seed valuation, a standard Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x implies a forward valuation of $18M. The Peer-Median method cannot be reliably applied due to insufficient narrow peer data; while eight robotics companies exist in the comp universe, fewer than three share sufficient stage, adjacency, or valuation-tier alignment to support robust median pricing.

Given the constraints of available data, the Stage-Progression method alone yields a point estimate of $18M. A conservative range around this single-method result spans $15M (low) to $20M (high), reflecting typical variance in step-up multiples across market conditions. Key uncertainties include the absence of dense peer valuation data at Seed stage in robotics, which limits cross-validation, and the degree to which Reflex's specific technology, traction, or market position may warrant adjustment from sector norms. Further disclosure of revenue, user metrics, or comparable financing rounds would strengthen conviction in this range.
